newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba jumps as 9-mo profit rises 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Veba jumps as 9-mo profit rises 25 pct.

text.p: Shares in German diversified energy, chemicals and services group Veba AG jumped to a new year high after the company announced a 25 percent increase in nine month net profit.

The stock hit a year high of 87.12 marks in pre-bourse electronic trade and then slipped back a little to stand up 2.48 marks, or almost three percent, at 86.48 marks. Veba was the most heavily traded stock in electronic dealings, with over a million shares changing hands.
Meanwhile the IBIS DAX index of 30 leading German shares was down 1.17 points, or 0.04 percent, at 2,763.13, having earlier hit an all-time high of 2,772.29 points.
Analysts had expected a significantly lower profit increase at Veba, and for profit growth to normalise after a run of record figures.
"The group net profit increase is way above our expectations and way above those of everyone else," said one analyst.
Group net profit rose to 1.227 billion marks against 980 million marks for the same period last year.
Veba also said it expected to see a clear increase in earnings in full-year 1996 and that it expected to maintain growth levels seen up to now.
